video_title: Wemby says he's not surprised Draymond hit him in back & laughs at their strategy

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the physical playstyle of the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I feel very secure. I know I have to be smart, but I feel very secure.
quotes.quote: They said before the game they wanted to be a little rough, a little physical with me. Draymond Green picked up that technical. When you are coming into a game with a guy like that, do you ever feel a little less secure in your bodily safety and do you make any preparations going into a matchup like that? No, I feel very secure. I know I have to be smart, but I feel very secure. And it's not a good basketball strategy and it shows. So, I'm ready to put my body on the line for the team if that allows us to win by 40.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's reaction to the Draymond Green flagrant foul
quotes.excerpt: Do I have any thoughts of it? Not much. I mean, it's not surprising.
quotes.quote: Do you have any thoughts on the Draymond Green shove, the flagrant foul? Do I have any thoughts of it? Not much. I mean, it's not surprising.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the joy of alley-oop plays with Stefan Castle
quotes.excerpt: Both are great. I can't choose.
quotes.quote: What's more enjoyable for you, catching an alley-oop from Stefan Castle or throwing an alley-oop to Stefan Castle? Both are great. I can't choose.
